page.overview:
Who is Guisin?

She is a tall woman with silver-gold hair.

Guisin is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

She is allied with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

The Salidar Six, led by Sheriam, send Guisin, Afara and Edesina Azzedin to Tarabon as emissaries of the Rebel Aes Sedai. All three were captured by the Seanchan and made damane.
